attendance_condonation.kiosk_access: You do not need to wander anywhere on campus to get this form. You can download it directly right here on this UniAssist screen using the button below, or open the Forms Catalog (/forms).
attendance_condonation.kiosk_access_hindi: आपको इस फॉर्म के लिए कैंपस में कहीं भी भटकने की ज़रूरत नहीं है। आप इसी स्क्रीन पर नीचे दिए गए 'Download Form AC-04' बटन पर क्लिक करके इसे तुरंत यहीं से प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।
attendance_condonation.kiosk_access_hinglish: Aapko is form ke liye campus me kahin bhatakne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Aap yahin UniAssist screen par niche diye gaye 'Download Form AC-04' button par click karke turant prapt kar sakte hain.
attendance_condonation.eligibility: Attendance between 60.0% and 74.9% (below 60% constitutes mandatory debarment).
required_documents: Authentic medical certificate with doctor prescription and hospital OPD slip
Or approved official university duty certificate signed by event coordinator
attendance_condonation.submission_office: Dean of Academic Affairs (Room 201, Academic Block)
attendance_condonation.deadline_sla: Submit at least 10 working days prior to exam start. Admit card is unblocked within 48 hours of Dean approval.

backpaper_exam.kiosk_access_hinglish: Aap Form EX-02 yahin screen par niche diye gaye button par click karke turant download kar sakte hain.
backpaper_exam.eligibility: Students with failed subjects or seeking grade improvement in previous semester courses.
required_documents: Copy of semester grade sheet showing failed / improvement course codes
INR 1,500 per subject fee challan / payment receipt
backpaper_exam.deadline_sla: Must submit within 14 calendar days of semester grade sheet publication.

program_withdrawal.official_name: Program Withdrawal & Tuition Refund Application Form
program_withdrawal.hindi_name: प्रवेश विड्रॉल एवं शुल्क रिफंड आवेदन प्रपत्र
program_withdrawal.kiosk_access: You do not need to run to any offices to get this form. You can initiate digital clearance and download the form directly on this UniAssist kiosk via the button below.
program_withdrawal.kiosk_access_hindi: आपको कहीं जाने की आवश्यकता नहीं है। आप इसी कियोस्क पर नीचे दिए गए 'Start Withdrawal Procedure' बटन से डिजिटल क्लियरेंस और फॉर्म शुरू कर सकते हैं।
program_withdrawal.kiosk_access_hinglish: Aapko kahin jane ki zaroorat nahi hai. Aap yahin kiosk par 'Start Withdrawal Procedure' button par tap karke digital clearance aur form turant shuru kar sakte hain.
program_withdrawal.eligibility: Any student requesting departure or admission cancellation under UGC refund guidelines.
refund_slabs: 15+ days prior to admission deadline: 100% refund (minus max INR 1,000 processing fee)
Up to 15 days post admission deadline: 80% refund
Refundable Caution Deposit (INR 10,000): Always 100% refunded across all slabs.
required_documents: Cancelled bank cheque or passbook copy showing IFSC code for NEFT refund transfer
program_withdrawal.submission_office: Registrar Office (Room 102, Administrative Block) after 4-gate digital sign-off.
program_withdrawal.deadline_sla: Refund credited to bank account within 14 working days of document verification.

smart_deposit_offset.kiosk_access: Available 100% digitally on this kiosk on the Withdrawal & Clearance portal (/withdrawal).
smart_deposit_offset.kiosk_access_hindi: इसी कियोस्क पर विड्रॉल और क्लियरेंस पोर्टल (/withdrawal) पर 1-टैप में उपलब्ध।
smart_deposit_offset.kiosk_access_hinglish: Yahin kiosk par Withdrawal portal (/withdrawal) par 1-tap me available.
smart_deposit_offset.eligibility: Students with pending dues under INR 2,000 (such as library fines or lost ID replacement fee of INR 200).
smart_deposit_offset.details: Directly deducts fine from INR 10,000 refundable caution deposit balance without physical bank visits or challans.
smart_deposit_offset.submission_office: 100% Automated Digital Clearance Gate on UniAssist.

faculty_resignation.official_name: Faculty & Staff Resignation & Relieving Clearance Procedure
faculty_resignation.hindi_name: संकाय एवं स्टाफ त्यागपत्र एवं रिलीविंग क्लियरेंस प्रक्रिया
faculty_resignation.kiosk_access: Download the Faculty Clearance Dossier right here on this UniAssist screen via the button below.
faculty_resignation.kiosk_access_hindi: फैकल्टी क्लियरेंस डोजियर इसी स्क्रीन पर नीचे दिए गए बटन से डाउनलोड करें।
faculty_resignation.kiosk_access_hinglish: Faculty Clearance Dossier yahin screen par niche diye gaye button se download karein.
faculty_resignation.eligibility: Faculty members or staff resigning from university service.
procedure_steps: 1. Submit formal written resignation notice to Department HOD and Dean of Faculty.

2. Complete 4-counter No-Dues Clearance: (a) Department HOD (handover course dossiers and lab keys), (b) Central Library (book returns), (c) Stores & IT (laptop, printer assets, and biometric deactivation), (d) Finance & Accounts (salary & PF reconciliation).
3. Submit completed dossier to HR Administration Desk (Room 103, Administrative Block).
faculty_resignation.deadline_sla: Relieving letter and experience certificate issued within 15 working days.
